meta.name: uae-grc
meta.description: United Arab Emirates Governance, Risk & Compliance advisor — a jurisdiction-first compliance router. In the UAE, WHERE an organization sits determines its law: mainland (Federal PDPL, Decree-Law 45/2021 — executive regulations still pending), DIFC (DP Law No. 5 of 2020 as amended 2025, with a private right of action), ADGM (DP Regulations 2021), CBUAE-licensed financial institutions (consumer-data residency, outsourcing approvals), healthcare (ICT Health Law data localization), and government/CNI (UAE IA Regulation, Cyber Security Council; Dubai ISR, ADHICS). Use for any UAE / Dubai / Abu Dhabi / Emirates compliance question: UAE data protection, DIFC or ADGM privacy, free-zone vs mainland obligations, health-data residency, CBUAE cyber and outsourcing rules, market entry ("expanding to the UAE"), breach notification, gap assessments, and mapping UAE requirements to ISO 27001 / NIST CSF / SOC 2. Trigger for any UAE privacy, cybersecurity, or regulatory question even if no framework is named.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按司法管辖区定位阿联酋数据保护与合规要求
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要处理阿联酋任一司法管辖区的数据保护与网络安全合规问题。
copy.tagline_en: Pinpoint the UAE data protection and compliance rules for your jurisdiction.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle data protection or cybersecurity compliance for UAE entities.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先确认你的组织在阿联酋的管辖区域(如 mainland、DIFC、ADGM)和业务类型,再列出适用的法规,并输出差距评估表、违规通报时限、市场进入路线图或 ISO/NIST/SOC 2 映射。
howto.when: 当你提出任何关于阿联酋的隐私、网络安全或监管合规问题时触发,即使未指定具体框架。

say.text: 我们是一家迪拜的诊所,存储病人健康数据,需要遵守哪些本地化要求?
say.note: 会按 ICT Health Law 说明本地化规则与罚则。

say.text: DIFC 公司被投诉隐私侵权,2025 年新规下我们有什么风险?
say.note: 会依据 DIFC 2025 修正案说明私人诉权等变化。

say.text: 我们想进入阿联酋市场,mainland 和自由区怎么选?
say.note: 会先确认你的情况,再给出法律适用路线图。

howto.what_en: Claude first confirms the organization's UAE jurisdiction (mainland/DIFC/ADGM) and type, then lists applicable laws and outputs gap tables, breach timelines, market-entry roadmaps, or ISO/NIST/SOC 2 mappings.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any UAE privacy, cybersecurity, or regulatory compliance question, even when no specific framework is named.

say_en.text: We are a Dubai clinic storing patient health data. What localization rules apply?
say_en.note: Runs the ICT Health Law localization rule and penalty range.

say_en.text: Our DIFC company faces a privacy complaint. What risks under the 2025 rules?
say_en.note: Explains DIFC 2025 changes like the private right of action.

say_en.text: We plan to enter the UAE. How to choose mainland vs free zone?
say_en.note: Applies the intake gate, then gives an applicability roadmap.
